ios.title: In Safari, in three taps:
ios.notifications: On iPhone, notifications only work with the web app installed.

windows.question: On a Windows PC, gaming?
windows.answer: Go with the Windows app: only it shows the game you're playing, opens with your computer and stays in the tray.

web.question: On a phone, a Mac or Linux?
web.answer: Install the web app. That's how Linkord becomes an app on those devices, and it gets notifications like a native app.

both.question: Can I use both?
both.answer: Yes. Your account, conversations and calls are the same everywhere, and you can install it on as many devices as you like.
